## Applied Paper 1 — Li et al. (2014): Gasoline Taxes {#sec-li2014}

## V.01 — Reduced Form {#sec-v01}

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Stata

```stata
ssc install did_multiplegt_stat, replace
use "https://github.com/chaisemartinPackages/ApplicationData/raw/main/data_gazoline.dta", clear

did_multiplegt_stat lngca id year tau, or(1) as_vs_was controls(lngpinc) cross_fitting(10)
```

### Python

```python
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import pandas as pd
from did_multiplegt_stat import DIDMultiplegtStat

gazoline = pd.read_stata(
    "https://github.com/chaisemartinPackages/ApplicationData/raw/main/data_gazoline.dta"
)

m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["aoss","waoss"], order=1, controls=["lngpinc"],
                       aoss_vs_waoss=True, cross_fitting=10, asinstata=True)
m.fit(gazoline, Y="lngca", ID="id", Time="year", D="tau")
m.summary()
```


### Python

```python
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import pandas as pd
from did_multiplegt_stat import DIDMultiplegtStat

gazoline = pd.read_stata(
    "https://github.com/chaisemartinPackages/ApplicationData/raw/main/data_gazoline.dta"
)

m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["ivwaoss"], order=1, controls=["lngpinc"],
                       cross_fitting=10, bootstrap=10, seed=1, asinstata=True)
m.fit(gazoline, Y="lngca", ID="id", Time="year", D="lngpinc", Z="tau")
m.summary()
```

## V.04–V.05 — On Placebo Sample {#sec-v04}

```python
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import pandas as pd
from did_multiplegt_stat import DIDMultiplegtStat

gazoline = pd.read_stata(
    "https://github.com/chaisemartinPackages/ApplicationData/raw/main/data_gazoline.dta"
)

# V.04 — reduced form on placebo sample
m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["waoss"], order=1, controls=["lngpinc"],
                       cross_fitting=10, on_placebo_sample=True, asinstata=True)
m.fit(gazoline, Y="lngca", ID="id", Time="year", D="tau"); m.summary()

# V.05 — first stage on placebo sample
m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["waoss"], order=1, controls=["lngpinc"],
                       cross_fitting=10, on_placebo_sample=True, asinstata=True)
m.fit(gazoline, Y="lngpinc", ID="id", Time="year", D="tau"); m.summary()
```

### Python

```python
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import pandas as pd
from did_multiplegt_stat import DIDMultiplegtStat

gentzkow = pd.read_stata(
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anzonyquispe/did_book/main/did_applied_book/data/gentzkowetal_didtextbook.dta"
)

m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["aoss","waoss"], exact_match=True,
                       placebo=1, asinstata=True)
m.fit(gentzkow, Y="prestout", ID="cnty90", Time="year", D="numdailies")
m.summary()
```

```python
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import pandas as pd
from did_multiplegt_stat import DIDMultiplegtStat

m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["aoss","waoss"], exact_match=True,
                       placebo=1, by_baseline=2, asinstata=True)
m.fit(gentzkow, Y="prestout", ID="cnty90", Time="year", D="numdailies")
m.summary()
```
